summary: Over the last 7 days you averaged 15.5 kg CO2e a day, mostly from home energy. The last few days were higher than the days before.

suggestions.title: Trim home electricity by about 10 percent
suggestions.message: Use about 6.9 kWh less a week: AC at 24 to 26 degrees, switch off standby devices, LED bulbs. That could save about 5.02 kg CO2e a week.

suggestions.title: Swap some beef meals
suggestions.message: Swap 1 of your beef or buffalo meals a week for a vegetarian option like dal, rajma or paneer. That could save about 4.6 kg CO2e a week.

suggestions.title: Take the bus for some car trips
suggestions.message: Swap about 30 km of car driving a week for the bus, starting with a route you already know. That could save about 1.93 kg CO2e a week.
